measure: The structural reads over the corpus. Per repository and selection, two analyses through the real AnalysisRegistry (RegistrySettings.production, Stages.production(), which wires STRUCTURAL_GRAPH) on fresh data directories; a daemon thread samples the size of analysis.sqlite-wal every millisecond during each analysis. After the terminal event, with the registry still open, every request goes through a Dispatcher built on Handlers.all and the production JsonLines.Writer into a buffer (Lifecycle's path for one frame, without stdin and the pipe), with the interface's parameters. Analysis 1: the read requests, each timed once (the first call, also the warm-up) and five more times, in the product's order; then the SWEEP, recorded as a transcript: level 1, every outline root page, per package the TYPE slice and every children page, and the seven searches; then the IT's own SQL over the persisted rows; then the closed cache. Analysis 2: the same sweep with the same request ids, compared byte for byte.

baselines.walPeakBytes: benchmarks/dependency-extraction.json (the last benchmark that recorded it)
baselines.rollupAndTypeCensus: level-1 aggregation and per-package type counts from an earlier analysis of the corpus, embedded as literals
baselines.referenceCaches: reference caches, closed, empty -wal; sizes embedded as literals

environment.storage: APPLE SSD AP1024Z internal NVMe SSD
environment.runtime: full JDK under Maven Surefire, not the jlink image the application ships

host.storage: APPLE SSD AP1024Z internal NVMe SSD
